description.la: In Lucae evangelium expositio libris sex, cum epistolis Accae et Bedae.
description.en-US: Bede's six-book exposition of the Gospel of Luke, the longest of his works, with the letters of Bishop Acca urging it and Bede's reply; it was widely copied and is quoted throughout the Catena Aurea. Latin text of Migne (PL 91-93); no public-domain English translation is known.
description.pt-BR: A exposição de Beda ao Evangelho de Lucas, em seis livros, a mais longa das suas obras, com as cartas do bispo Acca que a pediu e a resposta de Beda; foi muito copiada e é citada ao longo da Catena Aurea.

sources.edition: In Evangelium S. Lucae Beda on Latin Wikisource, from the Corpus Corporum TEI of Migne's Patrologia Latina.
sources.description: Wikitext removed; inline PL column numbers dropped; one file per book (or per part), chapter divisions kept as headings with their rubrics.
sources.tierEvidence: Eighth-century text in Migne's reprint of Giles: public domain.
